news.text: — Alperen Sengun had 29 points, nine assists and nine rebounds and the Houston Rockets remained unbeaten with a 120-110 win over the Atlanta Hawks Monday night.

news.title: Durant scores 22, Sheppard hits five 3-pointers to lead Rockets to a win in Atlanta's home opener
news.text: — Kevin Durant scored 22 points and both Reed Sheppard and Tari Eason had 19 points as the Houston Rockets beat the Atlanta Hawks 121-114.

news.title: Amen Thompson stuffs Wembanyama's last-second shot as Rockets hold off Spurs
news.text: Amen Thompson blocked Victor Wembanyama at the rim to prevent a potential tying bucket as the Rockets beat the Spurs 114-110.

news.title: Amen Thompson blocks Wembanyama in final second as the Rockets beat the Spurs 114-110 in Austin
news.text: — Amen Thompson blocked Victor Wembanyama's game-tying layup attempt with less than a second remaining and the Houston Rockets held on to beat the San Antonio Spurs 114-110 on Friday night.

news.title: Kyrie Irving hounded by Rockets in return, held in check in Mavs' blowout loss
news.text: With the Rockets focused on trapping him, Kyrie Irving was held to 15 points in his first regular-season game since March 2025 and the Mavs fell 128-110.

news.title: Rockets' Tari Eason ejected after shoving Mavericks' P.J. Washington in back
news.text: Rockets reserve forward Tari Eason was ejected in the first quarter Wednesday night after shoving Mavericks forward P.J. Washington in the back.

news.title: Durant and Smith each score 30 points to power the Rockets past the Mavericks 128-110 in the opener
news.text: — Kevin Durant and Jabari Smith Jr. scored 30 points apiece and the Houston Rockets used a big second quarter to build a huge lead and coast to a 128-110 win over the Dallas Mavericks on Wednesday night in the season opener for both teams.
